## P3 — bounded diagnostic traceability/evidence completion
Review round 1: https://github.com/artsafro/AGR-DigitalTwin-pilot/pull/109#issuecomment-6193798660
Head: d872fbfe8ac73af4df119a96094f2ed562fa3abe. Nonblocking documentation/evidence follow-up; no wrong numeric result observed.

The new `src/twinqa/geometry/component_volume.py` references Card #93 but neither a registered pattern nor explicit `new-case`. No matching pattern exists in the inspected registry. PR #109 reproduces the frozen 24-case matrix but does not provide a reproducible author beyond-matrix counterexample probe (or applicability explanation), nor regression-eval report/counts or explicit not-measured reason, as requested by docs/agents/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md.

Follow-up: mark this optional diagnostic `new-case` with bounded scope; add an author-owned reproducible synthetic invariant probe with command, seed/bounds and evidence path; record regression-eval passed/failed/not-measured counts with report path, or explicit missing-transcript/environment reasons. Do not fabricate telemetry or count not-measured checks as pass. Reviewer independently exercised 800 seeded checks and the matrix; these are not author-session telemetry.

Duplicate search found #99 for the separate CAD proxy; it does not cover this module.
